identities.name: Declaration name freshness
identities.semantic_statement: The name of an ordinary declaration being added is absent from the modeled pre-declaration environment.
identities.applicability: Checked addition of a safe axiom, safe definition, theorem, or safe opaque declaration.

identities.name: Declaration universe-parameter uniqueness
identities.semantic_statement: The declaration universe-parameter list contains no repeated parameter name.
identities.applicability: The universe-parameter list of every primary ordinary declaration kind.

identities.name: Declaration type free-variable closure
identities.semantic_statement: A declaration type contains no free-variable expression nodes.
identities.applicability: The declared type of every primary ordinary declaration kind.

identities.name: Declaration type metavariable closure
identities.semantic_statement: A declaration type contains no metavariable expression nodes.
identities.applicability: The declared type of every primary ordinary declaration kind.

identities.name: Declaration expression bound-variable closure
identities.semantic_statement: Every bound-variable occurrence in a declaration type or value is in scope at its occurrence.
identities.applicability: Expression checking reached from the type or value of a primary ordinary declaration.

identities.name: Export free-variable representability
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize whether an export profile can represent a free-variable expression and how each observer treats such an input.
identities.applicability: The pinned export format, parser revision, and observer input representation.

identities.name: Export metavariable representability
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize whether an export profile can represent a metavariable expression and how each observer treats such an input.
identities.applicability: The pinned export format, parser revision, and observer input representation.

identities.name: Declaration universe-parameter ownership
identities.semantic_statement: Every universe parameter referenced by a declaration type or value is owned by that declaration's universe-parameter list.
identities.applicability: Sort levels and constant universe arguments reached while checking a primary ordinary declaration.

identities.name: Constant universe-argument arity
identities.semantic_statement: A constant expression supplies exactly one universe argument for each universe parameter of the referenced constant.
identities.applicability: Constant expressions reached while checking a primary ordinary declaration.

identities.name: Declaration type well-formedness
identities.semantic_statement: The declared type is well typed in the modeled pre-declaration environment under the declaration's universe parameters.
identities.applicability: The declared type of every primary ordinary declaration kind, including safe axioms.

identities.name: Declaration type sort-valued requirement
identities.semantic_statement: The inferred type of a declaration's declared type is definitionally equal to a sort.
identities.applicability: The declared type of every primary ordinary declaration kind, including safe axioms.

identities.name: Declaration value well-formedness
identities.semantic_statement: A declaration value is well typed in the modeled pre-declaration environment under the declaration's universe parameters.
identities.applicability: Safe definitions, theorems, and safe opaque declarations; safe axioms have no value.

identities.name: Declaration value and declared-type compatibility
identities.semantic_statement: The inferred type of a declaration value is definitionally equal to the declaration's declared type.
identities.applicability: Safe definitions, theorems, and safe opaque declarations after both expressions are well formed.

identities.name: Theorem proposition-valued type
identities.semantic_statement: A theorem declaration's type satisfies the modeled proposition-valued predicate.
identities.applicability: Theorem declarations only, after declaration-type well-formedness and sorthood are established.

identities.name: Current declaration not visible during validation
identities.semantic_statement: The ordinary declaration currently being validated is absent from constant lookup in the modeled pre-declaration environment.
identities.applicability: Safe definition, theorem, and safe opaque type/value validation; unsafe recursive paths are excluded.

identities.name: Safe-declaration dependency restriction
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize whether a safe ordinary declaration may depend on constants marked unsafe or partial.
identities.applicability: Constant lookup while checking a safe primary ordinary declaration under the pinned profiles.

identities.name: Binder domain sort-valued requirement
identities.semantic_statement: The type annotation of a lambda or dependent-function binder has an inferred type definitionally equal to a sort.
identities.applicability: Lambda and dependent-function expressions reached while checking a primary ordinary declaration.

identities.name: Dependent-function codomain sort-valued requirement
identities.semantic_statement: The codomain of a dependent-function expression has an inferred type definitionally equal to a sort in the extended local context.
identities.applicability: Dependent-function expressions reached while checking a primary ordinary declaration.

identities.name: Let annotation sort-valued requirement
identities.semantic_statement: A local let annotation has an inferred type definitionally equal to a sort.
identities.applicability: Let expressions reached while checking a primary ordinary declaration.

identities.name: Let value and annotation compatibility
identities.semantic_statement: The inferred type of a local let value is definitionally equal to its annotation.
identities.applicability: Let expressions reached while checking a primary ordinary declaration after annotation/value well-formedness.

identities.name: Application function-type requirement
identities.semantic_statement: The inferred type of an application function is definitionally equal to a dependent-function type.
identities.applicability: Application expressions reached while checking a primary ordinary declaration.

identities.name: Application argument and domain compatibility
identities.semantic_statement: The inferred type of an application argument is definitionally equal to the function domain expected at that application.
identities.applicability: Application expressions reached while checking a primary ordinary declaration after function-type and argument well-formedness.

identities.name: Projection expression typing
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize the typing predicate for a projection expression relative to its structure expression and authoritative inductive metadata.
identities.applicability: Projection expressions encountered in primary declarations; metadata validity remains outside the first slice.

identities.name: Axiom admission policy
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize whether an observer admits, rejects, skips, or conditionally permits a serialized axiom after type conformance.
identities.applicability: Safe and unsafe serialized axiom records under each pinned observer configuration.

identities.name: Axiom safety-flag treatment
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize how each observer reconstructs and acts on the serialized unsafe flag of an axiom.
identities.applicability: Serialized axiom records under the pinned exporter, parser, and observer profiles.

identities.name: Ordinary declaration safety reconstruction
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize how each observer reconstructs and selects validation behavior from serialized safety metadata on ordinary declarations.
identities.applicability: Serialized definition and opaque declaration records under the pinned profiles.

identities.name: Unsafe and partial replay filtering
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize whether an observer replays, skips, rejects, or transforms constants marked unsafe or partial.
identities.applicability: Observer environment construction surrounding ordinary declaration checking.

identities.name: Observer replay environment construction
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize the declaration ordering, dependency replay, filtering, and reconstruction steps that build the environment presented to validation.
identities.applicability: The pinned official importer, Nanoda parser/cutoff, Lean4Lean replay, and Kiota streaming parser profiles.

identities.name: Observer current-declaration visibility
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize whether the declaration currently being checked is visible through constant lookup in each observer's reconstructed environment.
identities.applicability: Ordinary declaration checking under each pinned observer's replay or streaming construction strategy.

identities.name: Literal availability policy
identities.semantic_statement: Characterize how primitive availability and observer configuration control the acceptance of literal expressions.
identities.applicability: Literal expressions encountered in ordinary declarations under pinned observer configurations; native extensions remain out of primary scope.

seed_resolutions.reason: Four enforcement locations expose one duplicate-name boundary despite different layers.
Parameter-list uniqueness is distinct from ownership at expression use sites.
Free-variable and metavariable closure are separately observable and have different export representability.
Retain loose-bound-variable scope as a stable predicate without deciding whether the eventual catalog subsumes it under general expression well-formedness.
The format may evolve to represent either expression form independently.
Sort-level and constant-argument checks enforce one declaration-owned parameter set; observer disagreement remains evidence, not a separate semantic ID.
Arity is independently violable and does not collapse into parameter ownership.
A type expression can be well typed while its inferred type is not a sort.
Value well-formedness is independently testable before declared-type compatibility.
Compatibility is independently testable after value and declared type well-formedness.
This theorem-only predicate has a distinct reach condition and negative witness shape.
Pre-insertion and cutoff mechanisms implement the same candidate boundary; Kiota's contrary behavior remains an observer mapping.
The boundary is stable enough to name, but current evidence does not resolve normative-candidate versus empirical-policy kind.
Binder-domain and dependent codomain sort failures are independently constructible.
Annotation sorthood and value/annotation compatibility can fail independently.
Non-function application and argument/domain mismatch are distinct observable predicates.
Reserve the identity but defer kind and catalog inclusion until projection-metadata authority is in scope.
Axiom header conformance reuses declaration-type identities; admission and safety-flag treatment are distinct empirical scenarios.
Field reconstruction and replay filtering are independently observable profile effects.
General environment construction and current-declaration visibility can vary independently.
Reserve the empirical identity while retaining literal/native policy outside the first primary study.

nonclaims: A stable ID names a research object; it does not establish its authority, layer, or truth.
UNRESOLVED intended kind is preserved where policy and logical-validity interpretations remain unsettled.
No identity in this registry is yet a canonical characterization catalog entry.
Observer disagreements remain mappings to an identity and do not create checker-specific semantic IDs.
No Arena coverage denominator, mutation campaign, or witness synthesis is authorized by this registry.
